final_summary:
PR [#89](https://github.com/Marsuu1994/mars-workbench/pull/89) is open and ready for review, and all 8 CI checks pass on its latest commit, including Playwright and Vitest. I've unsubscribed from its activity, so review comments won't come back to this session.

**What changed per page** (one commit per page, plus one for docs; no behaviour change):
- **Board**: `KanbanBoard` became `BoardPage` and took over `BoardScreen`'s layout and header; `BoardScreen` is deleted. The mobile "pull to Todo" comes from a new `BoardPageContext`, so `MobileBacklogCard` no longer takes `onPull`.
- **Priorities**: `PriorityMatrixPage` became `PrioritiesPage`, and `PrioritiesScreen` is deleted.
  - The route's "which week to show without a plan" logic moved into an adapter, `toPrioritiesPageProps`.
  - Two helpers, `groupTasksByQuadrant` and `isTrackedTask`, replace inline code; the tracked check had been written twice. All three have unit tests.
  - Track, Done, the popover, the mobile sheet and Add come from `PrioritiesPageContext`. The quadrant cell and the card each go from 9 props to 2.
- **Dump**: `DumpScreen` became `DumpPage`. Capture and load more come from `DumpPageContext`. The route's unwrapping of the feed and its week badge moved into an adapter, `toDumpPageProps`, with unit tests.
- **Design Console**: scenarios render the new page components, passing their fixtures through the same adapters as the routes. Gallery specimens render inside contexts whose actions do nothing.
- **Docs**: `baseline.md`, AGENTS.md (Plan is now the only page not on the structure), the Design Console README, the tracker, and the README's Update Log and Current State.

**Checks that ran:**
- format, lint, typecheck, knip, check:themes and `npm test` all pass (430 tests, plus the 2 known expected failures).
- e2e: 26/26.
- I clicked through every context action on the live pages, desktop and mobile, and all 10 checks pass. My first attempts failed in my own script: it pressed keys before the page

notes: Paging: 7 pages of user+assistant events (463 events, 0 duplicate uuids: 287 assistant streamed events = 155 distinct message ids; 176 user events), plus 7 result events (result_index 0-6) found on 3 of those pages. The 8th page (before the oldest cursor) came back empty.

Usage cross-check: main-session dedup sums from assistant events (cache_creation 179,027 / cache_read 14,124,468) equal the result events' per-turn `usage` sums exactly, so the per-message dedup is sound. Subagent sums from the transcript (cache_creation 267,553 / cache_read 6,213,863) fall short of the cumulative modelUsage's implied subagent share (269,612 / 7,563,850) by ~2k / ~1.35M, so some subagent requests are not represented as transcript events; treat per-subagent transcript sums as lower bounds. Real output tokens (result events): 101,130 cumulative incl. 17,526 thinking; main-session turns 44,217 of that; assistant-event output_tokens (3,823 total) are streaming placeholders.

Cost (list, from result events): $9.16 total; 84 model turns across 7 result events; the long turn after the Priorities hand-back (05:34:09→06:02:47, 48 turns, 28.7 min) carried the cherry-picks, checks, e2e, click-through scripting, ui-verifier, docs, push and PR.

Setup: `npm run setup` ran in the foreground inside the branch-creation command, 05:25:56→05:28:15 (139 s). The three page agents were spawned right after (05:28:36, 05:28:51, 05:29:02), each with isolation=worktree and a prompt that hard-links node_modules from the main checkout; their launch acks all arrived ~05:29:05, i.e. the Agent calls returned only after all three were issued.

Stop-hook feedback 3 times (05:29:52, 05:31:49, 05:32:14): `~/.claude/stop-hook-git-check.sh` flagged untracked `.claude/worktrees/` (the agents' worktrees). The session refused to commit them each time and on the third added the folder to `.git/info/exclude`.

Merge strategy changed mid-way: first `git merge --no-ff` of the Board branch (05:31:26), then `git reset --hard 1ae70f7` and cherry-picks instead to keep one commit per page (05:31:32 Board 4614d1a, 05:32:09 Dump 4fd6156, 05:34:09 Priorities 47370cb).

One real merge conflict: the Priorities cherry-pick (47370cb) conflicted in the two shared Design Console files src/app/design/constants.ts and src/app/design/tabs/DomainTab.tsx (both sides added inert page contexts / fixtures). The literal 'CONFLICT' never appears in the transcript because the command's output was piped through `tail -5`; evidence is the `git diff` showing `diff --cc` and the `git add -A src && git cherry-pick --continue` at 05:34:22. Resolved by a python script keeping both sides ('Simple union conflicts; resolve by keeping both.').

Tool errors: 7. Four are the worktree-isolation guard refusing a subagent Bash command as 'too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree' (Board x1, Dump x2, Priorities x1; each retried with a simpler command). Three in the main session are benign exit codes: `pkill -f` exit 144 twice (05:57:39, 06:02:32) and `ls` of absent PR-template paths exit 2 (06:01:50).
Checks on the combined branch: format + lint/typecheck/knip/check:themes/npm test in one loop (05:34:33→05:36:00, all exit 0), then `npm run test:e2e` (05:36:03→05:38:04, exit 0, reported 26/26).

Unusual time sink: 05:38:08→05:57:46 (~19.6 min, ~22 Bash calls) the main session hand-wrote and debugged a Playwright click-through script against a live dev server; several FAILs were its own script races (keys pressed before hydration, rapid Dump captures), which it confirmed by running the same script against an unchanged `main` worktree on port 3001 as a control. Only afterwards did it delegate the Board browser check to ui-verifier (05:57:59→06:00:42, 6/6 checks pass; two pre-existing Design Console quirks noted and left alone).

ui-verifier was requested in the foreground (run_in_background=false; result stats say requested.foreground=1) yet its tool_result reads 'Async agent launched successfully' and arrived 2 min after the spawn (05:59:59); its hand-back and task-notification share the timestamp 06:00:42.

Docs, commit and push happened in one Bash at 06:01:40 (commit 7d0b6c0 'Docs: every page but Plan on the page structure', `git push -u origin claude/page-structure-b1`); PR #89 opened via mcp__github__create_pull_request at 06:02:21 (no PR template found), then subscribe_pr_activity.

Waiting on CI: three PR-activity wake-ups (Vercel comments at 06:02:49, 06:03:20; 06:05:40) each handled with ReadNotifications; at 06:05:43 pull_request_read get_check_runs showed all 8 checks success (Playwright, Vitest, ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript, theme contract, knip, Vercel preview) — 3.4 min after PR creation, 4.0 min after the push; it then unsubscribed and ended with 'Per the run rules, my work ends here'.

No questions asked to nobody: every main-session text is status narration, none asks for a decision or permission. No model fallback: all 287 assistant events are claude-opus-5-5 and result events carry fallback_credit null. No retries of failed pushes or commits; one push, four commits (three by subagents in their worktrees, one by main).

Subagent `<usage>` blocks (task-notifications): Board 91,438 tokens / 16 tool uses / 139.7 s; Dump 102,717 / 26 / 182.2 s; Priorities 144,937 / 33 / 302.3 s; ui-verifier 44,957 / 14 / 161.0 s. All four completed; the page agents each committed once on their own branch and did not push, as briefed.
Session left one open tracker item (write up the Q9 comparison, then archive the spike and experiment docs together) and did not archive the spike.
